note: PROPOSED ACCEPTANCE CASES, NOT TEST EVIDENCE. Nothing here has been executed. Observed results live in docs/modules/M03/acceptance.json and in dev/evidence/, and are written only after a run.

cases.name: teacher double-booking rejected
cases.given: A draft placing T1 in C1 P1 and C2 P1 on the same weekday
cases.expect: validate reports teacher_double_booked with both slot_ids and teacher_id; publish returns 409 state_conflict timetable.error.conflicts_present and the draft stays draft

cases.name: class overlap rejected
cases.given: A draft placing C1 in two slots whose period windows overlap on one weekday
cases.expect: 422 timetable.error.duplicate_slot at write time for an identical period, and section_double_booked from validate for overlapping distinct periods; the unique constraint refuses it in the database as well

cases.name: holiday excluded
cases.given: 2026-07-16 has a holiday exception
cases.expect: get_current_timetable returns is_school_day false, reason_key timetable.reason.holiday and zero sessions; get_calendar agrees; a substitution on that date is 409 timetable.error.date_is_holiday

cases.name: current version selected correctly
cases.given: V1 effective 2026-06-01 and V2 published effective 2026-09-01
cases.expect: a read for 2026-08-31 resolves V1, a read for 2026-09-01 resolves V2, and V1's effective_to is closed at 2026-08-31 rather than V1 being deleted

cases.name: historical version remains available
cases.given: V1 superseded by V2
cases.expect: V1 is still listable and readable with its whole grid, and a session on a date inside V1's range still reports timetable_id V1 with V1's version number

cases.name: revision does not duplicate attendance identity
cases.given: V2 republishes the same weekly grid for C1 P1
cases.expect: timetable_session_id for C1 on a date under V2 equals the id the same section, date and slot code produced under V1

cases.name: substitution expires
cases.given: The expired substitution on 2026-07-08 and the clock at 2026-07-15T04:30Z
cases.expect: get_teaching_authority reports substitute_teacher_id null and substitution_valid_until null; the active 2026-07-15 substitution reports T2 with its valid_until

cases.name: substitution is never a standing permission
cases.given: A substitution request with valid_until beyond the end of its own school day
cases.expect: 422 timetable.error.valid_until_after_session_day

cases.name: concurrent publish conflict
cases.given: Two publishes of the same draft, both sending expected_version 1
cases.expect: one 200, one 409 version_conflict; exactly one published version exists and exactly one TimetablePublished event was appended

cases.name: unrelated class denied
cases.given: T2, for whom Registry reports no assignment to C1, reads C1's schedule
cases.expect: 403 action_denied

cases.name: two-school isolation
cases.given: A School A actor names a School B section, timetable or session id
cases.expect: 404 object_inaccessible in every case, never 403, so existence is not disclosed

cases.name: relationship denial for a guardian
cases.given: G2, who guards only S3 in C2, reads C1's schedule with student_id S1
cases.expect: 403 action_denied; G1 reading C1 with student_id S1 succeeds

cases.name: stale edit
cases.given: A draft replaced with expected_version 1 after another writer moved it to 2
cases.expect: 409 version_conflict, and the grid is unchanged

cases.name: published grid is immutable
cases.given: A PUT against a published version
cases.expect: 409 timetable.error.not_draft

cases.name: transaction rollback leaves no audit or outbox row
cases.given: A publish that fails after the audit and event writes
cases.expect: no timetable state change, no audit row and no outbox row; the Platform test adapter asserts all three

cases.name: publication notifies only after commit
cases.given: A successful publish
cases.expect: an outbox row appended in the same transaction and no direct send; no notification port is consumed, so an SMS outage cannot block publication

cases.name: invalid input
cases.given: A period whose end equals its start, an unknown slot code, an unknown query parameter, a hand-edited cursor, and a body carrying school_id
cases.expect: 422 with the matching module message_key in each case, and error.server_internal_field_rejected for the last

cases.name: teacher unavailability blocks publication
cases.given: T1 unavailable 2026-07-20T03:00Z to 2026-07-21T03:00Z and a draft effective over that window
cases.expect: validate reports teacher_unavailable naming the date and the slot; publish is refused

cases.name: exam day is still a teaching day
cases.given: 2026-07-22 has an exam exception
cases.expect: is_school_day true, kinds ['exam'], and its periods remain eligible for attendance

cases.name: cancelled session is shown, not lost
cases.given: C1 P1 on 2026-07-15 cancelled
cases.expect: the session is returned with cancelled true and its reason key; get_teaching_authority reports eligible_for_attendance false; the recurring schedule is unchanged and no new timetable version exists

cases.name: subject-filtered roster reaches the pupil view
cases.given: S2, who takes malayalam only
cases.expect: the maths period is returned with enrolled false and the malayalam period with enrolled true

cases.name: both locales render
cases.given: The weekly editor, conflicts list, publish preview and read-only schedules
cases.expect: every string resolves from the module catalogue in en and ml; no message key renders as itself

pending_integration.name: real attendance authorisation for a dated substitution
pending_integration.why: M04 does not exist and real Access is not bound in standalone. M03 proves that it publishes the trusted fact and that the fact expires; it cannot prove that attendance honours it.
pending_integration.run_when: M04 is implemented and real Access is bound (Section C)

pending_integration.name: real authentication and 2FA
pending_integration.why: Standalone derives a fixed synthetic persona on loopback. The stale-2FA path on publish is exercised against the fake only.

pending_integration.name: real Registry provider
pending_integration.why: Section, subject, staff and year existence are unvalidated because the frozen RegistryPort exposes no lookup for them (ports.md gaps 1-4).
pending_integration.run_when: the proposed additive Registry signatures are reviewed and M02 provides them
